lines.x: The Dominican peso gained 5.43% against the US dollar on Thursday, according to central bank data.
Former Central Bank of Chile president Vittorio Corbo projects Dominican Republic growth of 4.6% in 2026.
Santiago Hazim, former director of Senasa and the main defendant in an alleged fraud of nearly RD$16,000 million against the health insurer, was taken to a hearing that was later cancelled.
The reformulated budget bill passed the Chamber of Deputies with 127 votes and was sent to the Senate Budget Committee.
